subject.title: [Bug]: Embedded runner "Network connection lost" when LLM generates a tool call with large parameters (param generation latency > underlying request timeout)

question: Should OpenClaw solve #53540 by changing OpenRouter Anthropic streaming/default timeout behavior in product code, or by documenting/configuring the existing provider timeout as the supported workaround?
rationale: The source shows a plausible default failure path and an existing timeout knob, but deciding whether to add provider-specific tool-argument streaming behavior or keep this as operator configuration changes user-facing defaults and provider ownership.

options.title: Prove and fix OpenRouter streaming
options.body: Run a live OpenRouter Anthropic embedded-agent repro and, if confirmed, implement provider/runtime behavior that emits or preserves progress during large tool-call argument generation.

options.title: Document provider timeout workaround
options.body: Keep runtime defaults unchanged and close only after docs and diagnostics make `models.providers.openrouter.timeoutSeconds` the supported path for slow providers.

options.title: Defer until fresh repro
options.body: Leave the issue open but require a current live repro artifact before accepting runtime or provider changes.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix OpenRouter streaming
recommendation.body: Run a live OpenRouter Anthropic embedded-agent repro and, if confirmed, implement provider/runtime behavior that emits or preserves progress during large tool-call argument generation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent timeout extraction/refactor and adjacent OpenRouter/Anthropic stream commits make this the best available owner for the provider/runtime direction choice.
